title: Making the Telemetry Pipeline Measurable: An Edge IoT Testbed and Dataset for End-to-End Latency, Provenance, and Energy-Aware Benchmarking
abstract: arXiv:2610.35591v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Edge-centric IoT systems are increasingly evaluated through sensor values or platform features, yet the telemetry pipeline itself, the sequence of sensing, serialization, message mediation, ingestion, and persistence, is rarely released as a measurable object. This limits reproducible benchmarking of timeliness, provenance, and operational cost, especially in early-stage IoT design where real deployments and high-quality open data are often unavailable. I present a measurement-first edge IoT testbed and dataset that elevate timeliness, provenance, and energy to first-class telemetry dimensions. The testbed operationalizes a role-based event-driven architecture with explicit Source-Broker-Aggregator responsibilities and a schema-governed TelemetryMessage envelope (Avro) that embeds correlation identifiers and a uniform, cross-role vocabulary of stage-level timestamps. To trace mediation effects, I extend an MQTT broker (Eclipse Mosquitt

translated_title: 让遥测管道可测量：一个用于端到端延迟、溯源与能耗感知基准测试的边缘物联网测试床与数据集
translated_abstract: 以边缘为中心的物联网系统越来越多地通过传感器数值或平台特性来进行评估，然而遥测管道本身——即感知、序列化、消息中介、摄取和持久化这一序列——很少作为一个可测量的对象被公开发布。这限制了对时效性、溯源和运营成本的可复现基准测试，尤其是在早期物联网设计中，此时真实的部署和高质量的开放数据往往难以获得。我提出了一个以测量为先的边缘物联网测试床和数据集，将时效性、溯源和能耗提升为一等遥测维度。该测试床实现了一种基于角色的事件驱动架构，具有明确的源端-代理-聚合器职责划分，以及一个由模式治理的遥测消息封装，其中嵌入了关联标识符和统一的、跨角色的阶段级时间戳词汇表。为了追踪消息中介的影响，我扩展了一个MQTT代理（Eclipse Mosquitto）……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了一个以测量为先的边缘物联网测试床与数据集，通过基于角色的事件驱动架构和嵌入阶段级时间戳的遥测消息封装，首次将端到端延迟、溯源和能耗作为可测量的一等遥测维度进行基准测试。
en_tdlr: A measurement-first edge IoT testbed and dataset that elevates end-to-end latency, provenance, and energy to first-class measurable telemetry dimensions through a role-based event-driven architecture with schema-governed message envelopes embedding stage-level timestamps.
